format: SWORD zText module (BlockType=BOOK, CompressType=ZIP, SourceType=OSIS), decoded with pysword 0.2.8 (the same procedure recorded for ArmWestern).

conf.About: Eastern Armenian Bible\par Includes Genesis, Exodus, and the Gospels

licenseNote: SWORD conf declares DistributionLicense=Public Domain. Gentoo portage metadata and STEPBible label the same module 'freedist' (freely distributable). Both are permissive/holdable-verbatim; recorded here rather than collapsing to one label.

scope.declaredInConf: Includes Genesis, Exodus, and the Gospels

encodingAudit.strictUtf8Decode: all 6 blocks decode cleanly with utf-8 strict
encodingAudit.note: Only Armenian letters (Lu/Ll), spaces, and Armenian/Latin punctuation — no Latin letters, digits, mojibake, or fallback characters.

shiftEvidence.explanation: Non-empty verses after an omitted verse are renumbered sequentially, so they no longer line up with canon/KJV verse numbers; the shortfall is padded as zero-length tail records.

examples.Luke 1:47: contains the text of canon Luke 1:56 ('Mary remained about three months…'); the Magnificat (1:47-55) is absent from the module bytes
examples.Luke 1:59: contains the text of canon Luke 1:80 ('the child grew…'); the Benedictus (1:68-79) is absent
examples.Mark 9:44: contains the text of canon Mark 9:47; the disputed 9:44-46 are absent
examples.Matthew 12:43: contains the text of canon Matthew 12:47; 12:43-46 are absent

shiftEvidence.crossCheck: data/armwestern.json (1853 Western Armenian NT, KJV-aligned) has the expected text at 1:47/1:56/1:68/1:80, confirming ArmEastern is the shifted side.

decision: HELD — not imported. Byte audit found the 6-book scope and UTF-8 encoding are clean, but the module has 47 zero-length verses plus intra-chapter verse renumbering and at least two self-duplicated verses. Importing by SWORD index would place the wrong text under canon verse numbers. No data/arm-eastern.* files and no app.js changes were made. Awaiting a decision on whether to reconcile versification (Segond-style) or import as-is with a verse-boundary warning.
